method: Independent union of mapped hierarchy-port and assignment alias edges; remove selected receiver edges, route selected leaves to inserted outputs, count all original leaf inputs plus inserted buffer I loads at every final component. Enumerates zero counts explicitly; never uses max-only test. Native evidence still mandatory.

probe.assessment: A four-leaf probe is a native grouping and persistence API test. Cap/slew improvement is an optimization property of the full split, not guaranteed by the four-load cut. Existing r5 strict probe cap/slew guard may reject an otherwise structurally correct probe.
probe.capacitance_condition: C_after - C_before = C_BUFV2_I - sum(C_AO32_A2[4]) + delta_C_wire_or_model; positive when inserted input exceeds removed four inputs plus any model reduction. Fanout reduction alone does not imply reduced capacitance or slew.
probe.recommended_full_split_guard: Retain strict per-nonreset-root native capacitance reduction and non-regressed slew, exact predicted final root counts, 1..16 actual leaves at every inserted output, all membership/identity/clock guards, DC own-change replay plus SVF and fresh PT. Probe receipt must be labelled structural/API evidence and must not satisfy or claim electrical closure.
recommended_probe_scope: exact one proven identity BUF at same owner
all four selected AO32 A2 pins move to exactly one new net
new net exact five pins including BUF Z; all old unselected members unchanged plus BUF I
original root 213 to210; inserted output exactly4 actual leaves
original clocks and reset connectivity unchanged
record native before/after cap and slew without assigning electrical optimization PASS
native full STA/DRC and write_changes remain mandatory
start split from the identical original/seed map, using completed probe only as API evidence
